messages.content: What was the casualty number of the Battle of Waterloo?

message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on June 18 1815, resulted in roughly **25,000 total casualties**—killed, wounded, or missing—across all sides.  

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French & allied forces (including German contingents) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian coalition | ~22,000 |

These figures are estimates based on contemporary reports and later military analyses; exact numbers vary slightly among sources. The high casualty toll contributed to the decisive defeat of Napoleon’s army and marked the end of his reign.
